key_terms.مَصْفُوفَةٌ: Arranged in rows or lined up, indicating order and abundance
key_terms.وَنَمَارِقُ: Cushions or pillows, plural of namirah

ai.seo_question: What does 'Namariq Masfufah' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'masfufah' (rows/aligned) signifies not merely physical comfort but the spiritual order and harmony of the righteous, reflecting the divine justice that arranges their ranks in Paradise. This imagery contrasts with the chaotic suffering of the disbelievers, emphasizing that true luxury is rooted in spiritual alignment with God's will. The phrase underscores the tangible rewards for those who purify their souls through faith and good deeds.
